authority: Latest V7 ONNX/online implementation direction in docs/OPERATING_DIRECTION.md
purpose: Implement actual ONNX inference and own matured-label online learning inside isolated native V7 while preserving original trading behavior; collect normal bounded learning and economic evidence
derive_once: Two independent physical source copies from exact baseline, no shared Include tree or cross-root import. Separate release/execution/Portfolio/Magic/core/research/learning paths; both refuse non-Tester execution before startup.
economics: Exact V7 original entries, order timing, direction, lot staircase, Passive0.01, 4%/12% risk, margin45%, all protection/RC4 management/exits and transaction ordering. Predictions and updates are observation only and have no path into trading return values or parameters.

learning.features: At an actual BIRTH,14 bounded causal columns: six component one-hot, six component-gated feature/(1+abs(feature)), direction, direction*prior_signal_direction. This forecasts a realized lifecycle after acceptance; it is not an entry authorization or retrospective gate.
learning.onnx: Fresh standard float32 graph MatMul(features[1,14], online_weights[14,1])->score[1,1]. Weights are dynamic model inputs owned by the EA, not a claim that ONNX Runtime performs training. No closed candidate model/parameters are reused.
learning.initial_weights: 14 zeros at fresh Tester initialization; no historical or Live learning state adoption
learning.prediction: ONNX inference at BIRTH from current model weights; capture features, prediction and unique own position identifier. Nonfinite or failed inference records a model fault and never changes original trading.
learning.label: Own complete CLOSE accumulated stressed_net divided by original reserved planned risk; clip[-2,2] for update, retain raw outcome in evidence. Never train on rejected or unknown counterfactual opportunities.
learning.update_time: Queue completed label and consume only when close server_time is strictly earlier than current event time. Same-second predictions never see same-second closes. Forecast loss is scored before the weight update.
learning.update: Normalized online squared-error step: w_i=clip(w_i+0.05*(clipped_label-stored_entry_prediction)*stored_entry_feature_i/(1+sum(stored_features^2)),-2,2). No learning-rate or clipping search.
learning.checkpoint: Bounded own CSV checkpoints record graph/model identity, source-role identity, weights, counters, active entry features and pending labels. Tester runs always start fresh. This phase makes no live restart/recovery claim.
learning.observability: Forecast count, complete label count, update count, same-second delay, errors, raw/clipped loss and beginning/final weights. Inference/update/checkpoint errors invalidate engineering completion but do not alter V7 trading decisions.

native_pair.configuration: FPMarkets US30 M30 assembly, required US30/US100/US500, $100, USD, leverage1:100, Model4 Every tick based on real ticks, optimization/remote/cloud/visual off, shutdown after run
native_pair.order: Exact control then observational learner immediately adjacent under same terminal, source/SET identities, required contracts/swaps and complete M1/TKC input fingerprints
native_pair.platform_source: Physical generic binary/standard-library/private connection support only from preserved optimization/runtime/dd20-pcr2-portable; never execute the source Portable and never copy its strategy/state/profile/trade-history payload
native_pair.history_source: Physical required-symbol cache copies from preserved same-lane PCR2; preserve canonical original caches. Static symbol DB and whole required TKC hashes bound before/after pair; payload drift invalidates full pair and requires a clean replacement after correction.
native_pair.checks: Normal MetaEditor compilation, full native Tester results and bounded native logs/ledgers. Require100% all-required-symbol real ticks with no generated fallback, matching complete economic counts/profits/DD/epochs and zero trading/evidence faults. Learning activity must be complete and attributable, not dummy inference.
native_pair.platform_updates: Record automatic native build/spec/history changes as engineering corrections, never optimization failure or permission to compare unlike paths. Re-freeze and rerun full pair if necessary.

verdict_scope: Only NATIVE_ONNX_ONLINE_IMPLEMENTATION_OBSERVED_EXACT_V7_ECONOMICS_RETAINED or CORRECTION_REQUIRED. This campaign cannot declare economic ML improvement or promote Live. A later economic decision use requires a new prospective contract, not automatic activation of these predictions.
prohibitions: Test-only infrastructure, validators, parity/promotion checkers or CI
